# E0732: a lens writes an alternative of a disjunction the Cap'n Proto compiler cannot place in a union

A compiled lens writes a disjunction of structs as a member of a Cap'n Proto
union, so the compiler must find, for each alternative the lens copies, the
member that holds it. It follows paths of plain fields, and paths beneath a
struct literal of one alternative; a copy whose source lies beneath another
disjunction, selected only by a test above it, is one it does not place yet.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				r: {k: "a", y: {t: "p", m: string} | {t: "q", n: int8}} | {k: "b"}
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				w: {t: "p", m: string} | {t: "q", n: int8}
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			if v0_0.r.y != _|_ {
				w: v0_0.r.y
			}
			if v0_0.r.y == _|_ {
				w: {t: "p", m: ""}
			}
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			r: {k: "a", y: v1_0.w}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0732]: w in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 writes an alternative the Cap'n Proto compiler cannot place in a union
  --> lineage.cue:19:2
   |
19 |     "0.0->1.0": {
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^
   |
   = note: w in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 copies v0_0.r.y, a disjunction the compiler cannot place among the members of the compiled unions (Cap'n Proto rule unknown-union-write)
   = help: write the disjunction's field from a source field that is not beneath another disjunction
```
